name: Recolor palette
author: Lienzo UI
description: Recolors the whole design with a ready-made palette (Ocean, Sunset, Forest, Mono) or inverts its colors, keeping the contrast of the text.

commands.name: Palette: Ocean
commands.description: Maps every color of the design, background included, to a blue palette by brightness.

commands.name: Palette: Sunset
commands.description: Maps every color of the design to a purple, red and orange palette by brightness.

commands.name: Palette: Forest
commands.description: Maps every color of the design to a green palette by brightness.

commands.name: Palette: Mono
commands.description: Maps every color of the design to shades of gray.

commands.name: Invert colors
commands.description: Inverts the RGB of every color (light to dark and back).
